name: Ten-Object Café
description: A boutique café sidewalk with ten independently controlled objects.
style_prompt: Warm cinematic street photography with detailed natural textures, gentle daylight, realistic materials, soft shadows, steady eye-level framing, and natural colors.
scene_prompt: A lively boutique café sidewalk with a warm storefront, where two people, a small dog, outdoor furniture, a hanging flower basket, a street lamp, and a sidewalk sign occupy distinct parts of the scene.

objects.name: Shop window
objects.prompt: A large boutique shop window with a dark wooden frame, warm interior lighting, and neatly arranged merchandise visible behind clean reflective glass.

objects.name: Hanging basket
objects.prompt: A hanging woven flower basket overflowing with fresh green leaves and small bright red flowers.

objects.name: Street lamp
objects.prompt: A tall black cast-iron street lamp with an ornate vintage lantern and a narrow decorative metal post.

objects.name: Sandwich board
objects.prompt: A wooden sidewalk sandwich board advertising fresh coffee with clean handwritten white chalk lettering.

objects.name: Left chair
objects.prompt: A yellow metal café chair with a curved backrest and four thin legs.

objects.name: Right chair
objects.prompt: An orange metal café chair with a rounded backrest and four thin legs.

objects.name: Café table
objects.prompt: A small round dark-blue outdoor café table with a narrow central pedestal and a circular tabletop.

objects.name: Terrier
objects.prompt: A small tan terrier wearing a red collar and walking close to the pavement with its tail raised.

objects.name: Man
objects.prompt: A man wearing a dark gray jacket, beige trousers, and brown leather walking shoes, standing with a relaxed posture.

objects.name: Woman
objects.prompt: A woman wearing a teal wool coat, a cream scarf, black trousers, and dark ankle boots, standing calmly near the café.
